content: We have three possible product SMILES from earlier step (make_5_lvl2-apply_template-1) which are three variants of the target molecule (different protecting groups). The task now: "return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_5_lvl2-template_search-2 to the molecule below". The template_id is 1914389, and we need to apply it to each of the three molecules (the ones from make_5_lvl2-apply_template-1). The earlier apply_template calls gave results for two of them (the second and third). Need also for the first molecule: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO". Let's apply template to that.
